instruction.text: Are these statements about Remembrance Day today true or false?

feedback.finish: The symbol of Remembrance Day is a red poppy.

atoms.a: Remembrance Day services take place on the nearest Sunday to Armistice Day.
We only remember the soldiers that died during World War One.

feedback.finish: We use Remembrance Day to also think about those who died in World War Two and other, more recent wars.

instruction.text: The Cenotaph was built in London in 1920 as a memorial to the dead of World War One. Select it to learn more.

text: During Remembrance Sunday, there is an official parade involving veterans, as well as some members of the public.

atoms.b: The Poppy Appeal is a ((++charity shopping_centre)) that collects money by selling Remembrance Day poppies.
These poppies are usually made of ((++paper metal)) and can be worn on your clothes.
The money that the charity raises goes towards supporting ((the_government ++former_soldiers)), also known as veterans.

atoms.a: Where do you think Remembrance Day is celebrated?

feedback.end: Many cities all across the UK have their own services and parades for Remembrance Day.
